dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: It's useful to hear how the navigation is working in practice. Were you able to open the documents themselves, or was the difficulty mainly finding the right section?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Opening them was fine. The screen quite small, that's all. At the warehouse, somebody always asking me something, so I put the phone down and lose my place. At my desk I can read properly. The app is handy when I'm outside, but for a conversation I still prefer calling.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: We can keep administrative conversations by telephone. Is there a quieter part of your working day that generally suits you for contact?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: After the delivery team has gone out, usually better. Don't call right when everyone is collecting their paperwork, otherwise I also cannot concentrate. No fixed slot, though. If I miss your call, leave a message asking me to call back. No need to put account matters in the message.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I can note that contact preference and keep any callback message general. You can also tell us when you're busy, rather than trying to speak while you're handling work. dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I understand. If the issuers default, the fund value can drop, and when trading is thin, the bonds can be hard to sell.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll keep the remaining administration focused. Before we finish, was there anything else about accessing your documents that you wanted me to pass to the mobile support team?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Just the way it returns to the document list after I close a file. Sometimes I lose my place there. Not urgent, ah, and I don't need someone calling while I'm with the warehouse team. General feedback only. Otherwise I can manage.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I'll pass that navigation feedback to the relevant team without requesting a troubleshooting call. Thank you for explaining where it happens; that is more useful than a general comment about the app.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Thanks, Rachel. I'll leave you to the paperwork. Need to get back to the office now. Goodbye.
